title: DnaAlphabet
description: IUPAC nucleotide codes for DNA: A/C/G/T plus the standard ambiguity codes (R,Y,S,W,K,M,B,D,H,V,N). Also allows '-' and '.' as alignment gap/missing-data characters, since a Sequence doubles as an alignment row. Case-insensitive (lowercase is the common convention for soft-masked regions in genome assemblies).
